title: OECD Learning Compass 2030
evidence: Framework emphasizes student agency, well-being and competencies including knowledge, skills, attitudes and values. Potential curriculum review: decision-making and reflection.
limitation: A normative framework, not an intervention trial or direct evidence of Money Quest outcomes.

title: World Economic Forum Future of Jobs Report 2025
evidence: Employer survey highlights analytical thinking, resilience, flexibility, leadership, creative thinking and rising AI literacy. Explore age-appropriate critical thinking activities.
limitation: Employer expectations for workforce skills; not direct evidence of effective pedagogy for children.

title: UNESCO Global Education Monitoring Report 2023: Technology in education
evidence: Reports that accessible technology can support learners with disabilities, while independent evidence for many educational technologies is limited.
limitation: Global policy synthesis; not a test of specific Money Quest features.
